seed_facts.quota_verbatim: No stated quota. Four root collections on a movie and anime site
seed_facts.chaining_verbatim: A read-only mirror that demonstrates CDN fronting on a Chinese CDN rather than Cloudflare, which matters when Cloudflare is the wrong side of a network boundary for a given reader
seed_facts.reliability_verbatim: Alive but a mirror. The canonical domain is broken and assume the maintainer is consolidating, so this may vanish with the DNS record
seed_facts.tooling_verbatim: OpenList v4.2.6 REST API, anonymous. A guest WebDAV credential davguest:davguest is advertised in the index and was not retested here
seed_facts.binding_note_verbatim: Reads are free and cached at a Chinese CDN edge. What binds is the write gate and, behind it, that the primary host is already dead, so the whole surface rests on one DNS record.
